high_loading.loading_definition: coating_gap_um >= 150 um (mean active mass >= 11.0 mg) among strictly complete recipes

claim: In source-backed offline replay on eligible Drakopoulos manufacturing protocols, the AIcoScientist process-surrogate engine recovered the source-observed high-D30 recipe more frequently within five additional experiments than random selection.
limitations: Evaluated on physical retrospective experimental candidates rather than real-time prospective wet-lab synthesis.
All 300 um cells in Drakopoulos ASC workbook lack measured cycle 30 cycling data and were excluded from primary D30 rediscovery.
Published Alchemite design represents an aggregate comparative set in Table S6 rather than an isolated recoverable single-cell identifier.
